analysis.title: Deep Ocean Immersive Landing Page
analysis.notes: A dark underwater landing page uses vivid blue photography, beams of light, marine life, and coral textures to create a cinematic sense of depth. Oversized white headlines, translucent rounded cards, and centered sections organize the dense visual atmosphere into a polished editorial narrative.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a cinematic underwater hero image for a vertical editorial website: deep navy ocean darkness, brilliant cobalt-blue shafts of light descending from the surface, a translucent jellyfish drifting on the right, distant schools of fish, textured coral reef and a small starfish emerging from the lower foreground. Use rich volumetric lighting, suspended particles, subtle cyan highlights, strong central negative space for oversized typography, and a premium photographic art direction. No text, logos, interface elements, or recognizable brands.
